system.description:
A Disoriented creature suffers the effects of their equilibrium and sense of balance being impeded.

A Disoriented creature suffers a -1 penalty to attack rolls for each rank they have.

A creature with 3 or more ranks of Disoriented must spend its Bonus Action at the beginning of its turn to target one creature it can see. The target creature is the only creature they can target with attacks, jutsu or effects that requires them to select a creature to harm.

A creature with 5 or more ranks of Disoriented cannot make attacks as they cannot reliably target creatures.

Creatures that are immune to psychic damage or the Dazzled condition is immune to this condition.

A Disoriented creature can spend an Action to make a DC 15 Wisdom ability check to end this affliction. On a successful check, the condition ends.
system.summary: −1 to attack rolls per rank; must pick a single target at 3 ranks; can't attack at 5; DC 15 Wisdom to end.

rules.text: At 3 or more ranks it spends its Bonus Action at the start of its turn to pick one creature it can see: the only one it can harm. At 5 ranks it can't make attacks.
